claims.question: Which kernel module flavor is mandatory for NVIDIA Blackwell (B300/B200/B100) and Grace Hopper GH200 GPUs?
claims.skill_answer: Open kernel modules; proprietary modules are unsupported on that silicon.

claims.question: What PCI device ID does the gpu-operator validator fail to resolve for NVIDIA B300 GPUs?
What minimum Dell HGX B300 SXM6 GPU baseboard firmware version is required on XE9780/XE9785 chassis?
Which Redfish action reliably activates Dell GPU baseboard firmware instead of Chassis.Reset FullPowerCycle?
In what order must DOCA-OFED and the NVIDIA driver be installed on a B200/B300 host?
claims.skill_answer: DOCA-OFED first, then the NVIDIA driver.

claims.question: Which kernel module fails to autoload at boot when DOCA is installed after the NVIDIA driver, breaking fabricmanager?
Which apt meta-package installs the 4th-gen NVSwitch fabric stack (fabricmanager, nvlsm, libnvsdm) for driver branch 580?
Does the nvlink5-<branch> meta-package provide nvidia-smi / nvidia-utils?
claims.skill_answer: No; nvidia-open-<branch> must also be installed for full userland.

claims.question: Which driver version has a broken fabricmanager start script in gpu-operator managed-driver mode, and what is the minimum fixed version?
claims.skill_answer: 570.158.01 is broken; pin ≥570.172.08 or move to 580+.

claims.question: Do HGX 4-GPU SXM baseboards (e.g. H100 in XE8640) require nvidia-fabricmanager?
claims.skill_answer: No; no NVSwitch, so fabricmanager, DOCA, and NVLSM are all skipped.
